newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shaoneng plans six-for-10 scrip payout.
newsitem.headline: Shaoneng plans six-for-10 scrip payout.

text.p: Guangdong Shaoneng Group Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its shareholders would meet in the city of Shaoguan in Guangdong province on October 18 to vote on the firm's interim dividend plan for 1996.
The power supplier called for a distribution of six bonus shares for every 10 shares held for the first half of 1996, according to a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

Shaoneng said in its listing notice that it generated net earnings of 32.01 million yuan in the January-June period of 1996. A company spokesman reached by telephone said comparative figures are not available because the company did not compile interim results when it was not a public firm.
Shaoneng issued 25 million A shares at 8.60 yuan per share last month. The A stock was listed in Shenzhen on August 30.
Shaoneng forecast after-tax profits of 61.72 million yunn for this year, compared with 57.21 million yuan in 1995 and 51.89 million yuan in 1994.

Shaoneng said it currently has total share capital of 100 million shares, including 27.5906 million founder shares, 44.0294 million institutional shares, 3.38 million staff shares and 25.00 million class A shares. Shaoneng said it would channel the proceeds from the offer into its core business.
